usedFor: Salesforce records, such as “New Opportunity”, add people to Google Contacts through “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Opportunity” in Salesforce, then “Create Contact” in Google Contacts
bestTemplate.why: A new opportunity is a moment to save the person, and the action creates the entry in Google Contacts.

watchOut: “Update Contact” fires on updates, so one person can run “Create Contact” twice; Salesforce triggers here are polling.
